_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Rimworld Together egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Rimworld Together
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The server for Rimworld Together, the community multiplayer mod for RimWorld. Installs the self-contained Linux server from the mod's releases.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Rimworld Together: downloads the server from the mod's GitHub releases,
# checked against GitHub's checksum. Saves, users and configs are never
# touched; the server is replaced only once the new one has downloaded.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=RimWorld-Together/Rimworld-Together
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo") || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
else
    tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>/dev/null) ||
        fail "Rimworld Together has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $(gh-release tag "$repo" 2>/dev/null || echo 26.11.2.1)."
fi
assets=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag") || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) a=x64 ;;
    aarch64) a=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "Rimworld Together has no server for this CPU." ;;
esac
# The self-contained server (it needs no .NET installed).
asset=$(awk '{print $1}' <<<"$assets" | grep -xiE "Server-linux-$a\.zip" | head -n1 || true)
[ -n "$asset" ] || fail "Rimworld Together $tag has no Linux $a server to download."
sum=$(awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { print $2 }' <<<"$assets")

if [ -x RTServer ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag $sum" ]; then
    echo "Rimworld Together $tag is already installed."
else
    mkdir -p "$build/x"
    echo "Downloading Rimworld Together $tag ($asset)"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/server.zip" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q "$build/server.zip" -d "$build/x"
    [ -f "$build/x/RTServer" ] || fail "The download has no server in it."
    chmod +x "$build/x/RTServer"
    mv -f "$build/x/RTServer" RTServer
    rm -f GameServer
    echo "$tag $sum" > .raptor-version
fi

# The server writes the rest of its settings on first start; this makes it
# listen on the server's port from the start.
if [ ! -f Configs/ServerConfig.json ]; then
    mkdir -p Configs
    jq -n --argjson port "${SERVER_PORT:-25555}" --argjson max "${MAX_PLAYERS:-100}" \
        '{Name: "RimWorld Together Server", IP: "0.0.0.0", Port: $port, MaxPlayers: $max}' > Configs/ServerConfig.json
fi
echo "Installed Rimworld Together $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Rimworld Together release, such as 26.11.2.1, or latest for the newest one. It must match the mod version players have. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server browser.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: The description shown in the server browser.
variables.default_value: Welcome to our RimWorld Together server!

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players that can be online at once.
